title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库是Prof. Fernando Amaral的完整AI培训课程配套资源，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，包含Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for Prof. Fernando Amaral's Complete AI Training course, covering ML, DL, LLMs, GenAI, NLP, Agents, CV, anomaly detection, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, with Python hands-on projects and notebooks.
